title: 123 Cyber editorial dossier activation

selectedGap.reason: The owner selected one exact published organization for comprehensive, review-first dossier enrichment and editorial-template activation without autonomous acceptance or publication.

guardrailNotes: This refresh stages editorial-profile activation for human Admin Review and does not accept, publish or directly alter the canonical organization.

candidates.reviewerRationale: Coverage value: 123 Cyber can set editorial profile version to organization_editorial_profile_v1 because its published dossier already contains three cited capabilities, two programs, three relationships, current activity and specific first-conversation questions. Evidence: 12 durable sources from 123 Cyber Inc., ThinkOn, Canada.ca, Calian and ISED confirm the product catalogue, Montreal footprint, program participation, partner activity and certification boundary. Mission/Public Need read: Edge Data Processing remains unchanged and no new Mission Area or Public Need match is proposed. Unknowns: 123 Capture hardware, performance, accreditation and operational-use boundaries remain unverified; Enclave control allocation, accredited-assessor status, direct contracts, comprehensive customers, capacity and financing are not public. Reviewer action: Confirm the unchanged executive summary remains bounded, then set editorial profile version to organization_editorial_profile_v1 only if the existing evidence is sufficient.
reviewWarnings: Vimy Forge reports 123 Capture use with elements of the Canadian Army and Navy, but public sources do not establish supported hardware, performance benchmarks, accreditation scope or operational-use boundaries.
ThinkOn describes Enclave controls and party roles, but public evidence does not establish 123 Cyber as an accredited CPCSC certification body or allocate every provider-versus-customer control.
Exact-name CanadaBuys, Open Canada contract and federal grant probes found no direct 123 Cyber award, procurement notice or financing record.
